usage: A common noun for a professional writer, especially someone who writes books, stories, essays, or journalism. It sounds natural in everyday Hong Kong Cantonese.
Often used with words like 好出名 / 年輕 / 香港作家 / 女作家 / 科幻作家 to describe the writer more specifically.
You can use it for both full-time writers and people known mainly for their writing work; it is more about profession or identity than a single piece of writing.
In speech, 作家 is neutral and standard; for casual conversation, people may also say 寫作人 or direct descriptions like 寫小說嘅人 when they want to be more informal.
